summary: Define NGO deliverables, align logframes and work plans, and control scope changes. Explore the five-day practical course.
lede: Project scope management helps NGO project managers, coordinators and programme staff define deliverables and control changes to approved commitments. It involves gathering and verifying requirements, documenting assumptions, setting exclusions and acceptance criteria, and linking work packages to logframe outputs and indicators. Teams also assess how proposed changes affect budgets, schedules, staffing and partner responsibilities, then record decisions to keep scope aligned across plans and progress reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for NGO professionals who shape project commitments, translate approved designs into delivery work and maintain alignment as implementation conditions change.
prerequisites: Prior experience in NGO project, programme or partner-delivery work is expected. Familiarity with project proposals, work plans or logframes will help you apply the exercises; no programming is required.
